security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://server.arcgisonline.com; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://server.arcgisonline.com; worker-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Explore and download passive acoustic monitoring data
bundle.longDescription: Nereus is a desktop viewer for Nereus passive acoustic monitoring databases: deployments on a 3D globe, detection timelines, and downloads as MATLAB, R, Tethys XML or the raw data files.
